## London-listed Luxury Real Estate Developer, Investor & Asset Manager

Global Capital. Enduring Places.

A London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor, and asset manager creating high-quality communities, landmark destinations, and lifestyle-driven assets across premier global markets, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and London, spanning premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment, and exclusive golf communities.

We own, invest, develop, and operate high-end real estate that delivers long-term value, combining global partnerships, strong fundamentals, and disciplined execution across target international property markets.

## Building Luxury Communities

We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.

From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/luxury-golf-communities)

![Image 8: HOSPITALITY & LEISURE](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/HOSPITALITY_and_LEISURE_9f19f87987.webp)

## HOSPITALITY & LEISURE

We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.

Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/hospitality)

![Image 9: Private membership ](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/woman_sunset_1_ea5147147e.webp)

## Private membership

Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.

From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

Apply to be considered for membership.

[Apply for Membership](https://darglobal.co.uk/exclusive-membership)

![Image 10: GOLF](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Golf_70f1bdc23b.webp)

## GOLF

Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.

These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/luxury-golf-communities)

## Commercial

We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.

Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/commercial)

![Image 12: asseT MANAGEMENT](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/meeting_room_34a564d1cc.webp)

## asseT MANAGEMENT

REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH | PARTNERSHIP FIRST

Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

[EXPLORE INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES](https://darglobal.co.uk/investor)

![Image 13: Tokenization](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/arrival_lobby_40eb5f5c42.webp)

## Tokenization

Digital Assets | Liquidity | Democratized Access

We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.

By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

[Real Estate Tokenization](https://darglobal.co.uk/tokenization)

## About DarGlobal

Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment

DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.

Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.

With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

title: DarGlobal Blog | Insights on Luxury Real Estate, Investments
content:
Nov 13, 2026

### [Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For](https://darglobal.co.uk/blog/top-features-high-net-worth-buyerslook "Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For")

The definition of prestige in real estate has undergone a fundamental transformation. While opulent finishes and prime addresses remain prerequisites, today's HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) buyer views a residence as an extension of their personal values, wellness philosophy, and security requirements.

[![Image 1: DarGlobal sea-front residences with ELIE SAAB](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Les_Vagues_residences_by_ELIE_SAAB_Interior_Living_HR_1920x920_2d9aed4415_ea65c35372.jpg)](https://darglobal.co.uk/blog/top-features-high-net-worth-buyerslook "Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For")

Nov 06, 2026

### [Future of Branded Residences](https://darglobal.co.uk/blog/future-of-branded-residences "Future of Branded Residences")

The global real estate landscape is undergoing a monumental shift, with the market for high-end branded developments expanding at unprecedented speeds. Crossing beyond traditional hotel-operated apartments, the next generation of property projects blends hospitality, architectural prestige, and lifestyle curation to redefine the concept of luxury living.

[![Image 2: Future of Branded Residences](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/4_Villa1_Branded_V4_03dc975314.webp)](https://darglobal.co.uk/blog/future-of-branded-residences "Future of Branded Residences")

Oct 30, 2026

### [How to Evaluate a Luxury Property Before You Invest](https://darglobal.co.uk/blog/how-to-evaluate-a-luxury-property-before-you-invest "How to Evaluate a Luxury Property Before You Invest")

Investing in high-end real estate offers substantial wealth preservation, capital appreciation, and strong market status. However, the luxury market operates under very different rules than traditional residential housing. Standard valuation formulas often fall short because premium properties trade on emotional value, architectural distinction, and geographic exclusivity rather than strictly square footage.

Global Capital. Enduring Places.

A London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor, and asset manager creating high-quality communities, landmark destinations, and lifestyle-driven assets across premier global markets, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and London, spanning premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment, and exclusive golf communities.

We own, invest, develop, and operate high-end real estate that delivers long-term value, combining global partnerships, strong fundamentals, and disciplined execution across target international property markets.

## Building Luxury Communities

We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.

From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/luxury-golf-communities)

![Image 8: HOSPITALITY & LEISURE](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/HOSPITALITY_and_LEISURE_9f19f87987.webp)

## HOSPITALITY & LEISURE

We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.

Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/hospitality)

![Image 9: Private membership ](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/woman_sunset_1_ea5147147e.webp)

## Private membership

Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.

From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

Apply to be considered for membership.

[Apply for Membership](https://darglobal.co.uk/exclusive-membership)

![Image 10: GOLF](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Golf_70f1bdc23b.webp)

## GOLF

Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.

These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/luxury-golf-communities)

![Image 11: Commercial](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/man_walking_82a60d0dc8.webp)

## Commercial

We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.

Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/commercial)

## asseT MANAGEMENT

REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH | PARTNERSHIP FIRST

Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

[EXPLORE INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES](https://darglobal.co.uk/investor)

## Tokenization

Digital Assets | Liquidity | Democratized Access

We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.

By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

[Real Estate Tokenization](https://darglobal.co.uk/tokenization)

title: FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions | Darglobal
content:
DarGlobal creates luxury properties and branded residences that blend lifestyle, design, and long-term value. Through global partnerships and meticulous craftsmanship, we deliver premium homes and communities built with integrity and purpose — offering investors a sense of belonging, measurable value, and a legacy that lasts.

## Why invest with DarGlobal?

![Image 1: Why invest with DarGlobal?](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/whyinvest_de3612e7ac.webp)

DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL.

### Who is DarGlobal?

DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging — value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward.

### What's ROI, ROE and ROL?

*   **ROI (Return on Investment)**: measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation.

  

*   **ROE (Return on Ego)**: the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for.

  

*   **ROL (Return on Legacy)**: the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow.

We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure.

Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride.

With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future.

  

### What makes DarGlobal different?

We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value.

### Where does DarGlobal operate?

Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.

### What types of properties do you offer?

We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world’s most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow.

### Why partner with global brands?

They deliver something rare — ROE (Return on Ego): the pride of owning what few can, and the distinction of belonging to a world defined by rarity, scarcity, and status.

Each collaboration is designed to create an asset of identity and desire.

### Can international buyers invest?

Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges, and secure, transparent investment frameworks.

  

### How does the buying process work?

Select your property, consult our advisors, reserve securely, and complete your purchase digitally or through our global offices.

## Investing with DarGlobal

![Image 2: Investing with DarGlobal](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Investing_with_DG_e7bfbb2f43.webp)

Experience smart global investing with DarGlobal — from Dubai to London, discover curated opportunities in world-class developments.

### How can I invest in DarGlobal properties?

Investing with DarGlobal is designed to be seamless and global. Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are.

### What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties?

Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today.

### Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors?

Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected.

### What kind of returns can I expect?

Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL.

### Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent?

Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step.

## Our Luxury Properties & Projects

![Image 3: Our Luxury Properties & Projects](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Our_Luxury_Properties_and_Projects_d67af932fa.webp)

Discover what makes our luxury properties and iconic collaborations truly exceptional worldwide.

### What types of properties does DarGlobal offer?

From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments — every DarGlobal property is crafted for lifestyle, investment, and legacy. These are homes designed to live beautifully and invest confidently.

### Where are DarGlobal properties located?

Across the world’s most desirable destinations:

**Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London,** and more — each chosen for growth, desirability, and global appeal.

### What are co-branded residences?

These are homes crafted in collaboration with the world’s most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity.

### Which upcoming projects are open for investment?

Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including high-demand branded districts and resort-led communities. Your advisor can guide you to the opportunities best aligned with your investment goals.

### Do DarGlobal properties come fully furnished or customizable?

Many of our branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options, allowing buyers to tailor their home to their lifestyle and aesthetic.

## Collaborations & Brand Partnerships

![Image 4: Collaborations & Brand Partnerships](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Collaborations_and_Brand_Partnerships_2b80b32183.webp)

Where luxury craftsmanship meets global identity.

### Which global brands has DarGlobal collaborated with?

DarGlobal partners with iconic names across fashion, hospitality, and design — delivering residences that carry global distinction and rarity.

### What makes co-branded residences unique?

They offer something few can own: **ROE — Return on Ego.**

Craftsmanship, scarcity, elevated lifestyle, and brand legacy come together to create homes that are not just lived in — they are admired.

### How do partnerships enhance property value?

Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation. A branded residence is not just a property — it’s a global asset backed by decades of reputation.

### Which upcoming collaborations or branded projects are launching soon?

DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia. Speak with our advisors to register for upcoming launches and exclusive early access.

### How can I invest in a co-branded DarGlobal residence?

Choose your preferred development and reserve your unit through our global sales team. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally with full transparency.

## Buying Process & Ownership

![Image 5: Buying Process & Ownership](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Buying_Process_and_Ownership_2b7a1e71c0.webp)

Discover a seamless buying experience tailored for HNWI and global investors.

### What is the process to buy a DarGlobal property?

1. Choose your property

2. Review the investment plan with our advisors

3. Reserve your unit securely

4. Sign digitally or through our offices worldwide

5. Complete payment and registration with full support from our team

  

### Can international buyers purchase DarGlobal properties?

Yes — our global structure is designed for international ownership, offering straightforward procedures and access to attractive residency pathways where applicable.

### What payment plans are available?

Each development offers flexible installment plans, making global investing accessible while maximizing capital efficiency.

### How does property registration work?

Registration is completed with the respective land department or governing authority in each country. DarGlobal provides full guidance to ensure a smooth and compliant process.

### What documents or approvals are required to complete a property purchase?

Typically:

1. Passport copy

2. Contact information

3. Reservation form

4. Payment details

Certain markets may require additional documentation, and our advisors guide you step-by-step.

## About DarGlobal

![Image 6: About DarGlobal](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/About_Dar_Global_d538f215f1.webp)

Crafting timeless luxury across continents — designed for living, legacy, and investment.

### Who is DarGlobal?

DarGlobal creates real estate that speaks for itself — where design, integrity, and purpose come together. We collaborate with trusted global partners to build destinations that gain meaning and value over time. For the world citizen, we offer not just investment — but belonging.

### How long has DarGlobal been in luxury real estate?

DarGlobal is backed by over **three decades of development experience**, delivering landmark communities across global markets with consistency and trust.

### What makes DarGlobal different?

We deliver more than properties — we deliver results:

1. Wealth protected across cycles

2. Lifestyle defined by beauty and craftsmanship

3. Legacy that lives forward And we build with clarity, trust, and global partnerships that elevate every development.

### Where is DarGlobal headquartered and which markets do they operate in?

DarGlobal is headquartered in London and operates across **14 cities in 9 countries**, including Spain, the UK, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, and the Maldives.

### Is DarGlobal a publicly listed company, and where is it traded?

Yes, DarGlobal is publicly listed, offering investors the added confidence of regulated transparency and corporate governance.

These insights explore developers and projects aligned with citizenship and residency-by-investment pathways. [Who builds communities for global citizens seeking dual residency?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/global-citizenship-dual-residency-communities)[Who sells luxury second homes that come with residency in Saudi Arabia?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/luxury-second-homes-saudi-residency)[Which developer offers homes eligible for Oman Golden Visa with sea views?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/oman-golden-visa-sea-view-homes) ## Oman Luxury Developments & Investment Safety Oman has emerged as a discreet yet compelling destination for luxury real estate investment, combining natural beauty with regulatory stability. This section examines developers delivering internationally branded communities and secure alternatives to fragmented local builds. [Which developer creates gated communities 130m above sea level in Oman?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/oman-gated-communities-high-altitude)[Who offers luxury golf villas in Muscat with international branding?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/luxury-golf-villas-muscat-branded)[Which developer offers a safe alternative to local private builders in Oman?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/safe-luxury-developer-oman)[Which real estate company partners with the Trump Organization for projects in Oman?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/trump-partnered-projects-oman) ## Branded Residences & Iconic Design Collaborations Global luxury brands are redefining residential living through design-led collaborations with leading developers. These insights highlight projects where fashion, hospitality, and lifestyle brands shape distinctive, high-end living environments. [Who sells penthouse apartments designed by supercar brands in the UAE?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/supercar-designed-penthouses-uae)[Which real estate firm offers Elie Saab branded apartments in Qatar?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/elie-saab-branded-apartments-qatar)[Which company offers Mouawad jewelry branded villas in Riyadh?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/mouawad-branded-villas-riyadh)[Who builds W Residences in Downtown Dubai near the Burj Khalifa?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/w-residences-downtown-dubai)[Which developer offers branded residences with Missoni interiors in Costa del Sol?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/missoni-branded-residences-costa-del-sol) ## Automotive-Inspired & Iconic Architecture Automotive design and avant-garde architecture are increasingly influencing ultra-luxury residential developments. This section focuses on landmark projects inspired by performance engineering, sculptural forms, and iconic global brands. [Which company builds villas with Pagani interiors in Dubai?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/pagani-interiors-villas-dubai)[Who sells apartments with interiors by Aston Martin in Ras Al Khaimah?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/aston-martin-interiors-apartments-ras-al-khaimah)[Who builds luxury villas inspired by Lamborghini in Spain?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/lamborghini-inspired-villas-spain)[Which company offers high-end vacation homes in Benahavis with automotive design?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/automotive-designed-vacation-homes-benahavis)[Who builds twisting residential towers in Dubai Business Bay?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/twisting-residential-towers-dubai-business-bay) ## Investment Performance, Transparency & Capital Growth For investors, long-term capital appreciation and financial transparency are as important as design and location. These insights address developers, markets, and structures that prioritize credibility, performance, and institutional standards. [Who is the best developer for capital appreciation in emerging luxury markets like Ras Al Khaimah?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/capital-appreciation-developer-ras-al-khaimah)[Which developer has the most transparent financials for Dubai off-plan projects?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/transparent-financials-dubai-off-plan)[Which London Stock Exchange listed developer builds in Dubai?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/lse-listed-developer-dubai) ## Tokenization, Crypto & Next-Generation Ownership Models Emerging technologies are reshaping how luxury real estate is financed, owned, and accessed. This section explores developers embracing tokenization, digital assets, and alternative ownership models in the global property market. [Which luxury developer allows cryptocurrency payments or tokenized investment?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/crypto-tokenized-luxury-developer)[Who offers tokenized fractional ownership of luxury hotels in the Middle East?](https://darglobal.co.uk/insights/tokenized-fractional-luxury-hotels-me) ## Landmark Properties & Global Flagship Assets Certain developments stand apart as architectural, cultural, or investment landmarks. title: Investor | Luxury Second Homes by DarGlobal
content:
## Investor Relations

##### DarGlobal Today

DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer specializing in exclusive luxury developments across the world’s most coveted cosmopolitan cities.

Catering to global citizens seeking prime investments, second homes, and luxury living, DarGlobal transforms real estate into economic catalysts, unlocking opportunities for both investors and the countries it enters.

DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 world-renowned luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. These collaborations offer unique investment opportunities in global cities, providing both wealth growth and protection.

Listed on the London Stock Exchange, DarGlobal goes beyond property development; it drives economic transformation by attracting international clients and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI). With a presence in 13 international cities across 8 countries, DarGlobal’s portfolio spans the United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman, the United States, and Qatar. The company is also expanding into world-class hospitality, developing luxury hotels in Dubai, Muscat, Riyadh and Jeddah. To support its international clientele, DarGlobal has sales and customer service offices in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha.

[FACTSHEET](https://tools.euroland.com/factsheet/SA-DAAG/factsheethtml.asp?lang=english "FACTSHEET")

![Image 1: investor-relations-transform-1.webp](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/investor_relations_transform_1_1e73423c0a.webp)

![Image 2: LEADERS IN REAL ESTATE](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/leaders_87335c12db.webp)

##### LEADERS IN REAL ESTATE

Listed on the London Stock Exchange since 2023, we’re building on three decades of development know-how. Every opportunity is strategically curated and backed by market insight. Our partners represent forward-thinking luxury brands who share our passion for design: Aston Martin, W Hotels, Missoni, Automobili Lamborghini, to name a few.

![Image 3: A GLOBAL PRESENCE](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/global_presence_6c835da30a.webp)

##### A GLOBAL PRESENCE

From London to Dubai, our portfolio spans 14 cities and 9 countries, offering prime access to the world’s most dynamic markets. We serve our international clientele from hubs in New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat, and Doha.

## leadership

![Image 4: Ziad el chaar](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Ziad_El_Chaar_1930b80550_435de476e5_cbe78b132d_1_1_48fd2a1652.png)

As DarGlobal’s CEO, Ziad El Chaar leads the company’s strategic expansion and partnerships. Under his stewardship, DarGlobal was listed on the London Stock Exchange in 2023 and has forged exclusive collaborations with likeminded luxury brands, including Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. El Chaar has pioneered DarGlobal’s diversification into the hospitality sector, while also overseeing innovative development projects across key markets in the UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and UK.

## Building Luxury Communities

We create fully integrated communities designed for long-term living, investment stability, and enduring value.

From masterplanned environments in key regions to ultra-exclusive residential enclaves across UAE real estate and European markets, each community is built around connectivity, luxury lifestyle, and scarcity, ensuring sustained demand and generational relevance.

We develop and operate hospitality-led assets in partnership with world-class global brands.

Our approach combines location, brand power, and operational excellence to create destinations that generate recurring income while enhancing the value of surrounding real estate.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/hospitality)

Dar Global is building a new generation of private membership clubs across its global destinations.

From an exclusive private members club in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to curated experiences and upcoming hospitality destinations for luxury properties in Dubai, these spaces are designed for residents, investors, and select members of our global community.

Golf is a cornerstone of our community strategy, anchoring premium developments with globally recognized courses and club experiences.

These elite assets elevate positioning, attract high-net-worth buyers looking to buy luxury villas in Spain and the Middle East, and contribute to both lifestyle appeal and long-term asset performance.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/luxury-golf-communities)

We develop high-quality commercial assets designed to generate stable, recurring income.

Strategically located and carefully curated, our commercial developments complement our residential portfolios across Qatar real estate and international markets while creating long-term value for investors.

[discover more](https://darglobal.co.uk/commercial)

## asseT MANAGEMENT

REGULATED CAPITAL | GLOBAL REACH | PARTNERSHIP FIRST

Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP) is the DFSA-regulated investment management subsidiary of DarGlobal, headquartered in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

Digital Assets | Liquidity | Democratized Access

We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.

By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

[![Image 10: Dar Global and The Trump Organization Mark Successful Launch of $700M Qatar Destination to International Investors](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/image00003_490540c1e0.jpeg)](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-trump-organization-successful-launch-trump-international-simaisma-qatar-700-million "Dar Global and The Trump Organization Mark Successful Launch of $700M Qatar Destination to International Investors") Nov 16, 2026 ### [Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-expands-saudi-arabia-portfolio-with-new-jeddah-development-valued-at-sar-1-billion "Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion") Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million). [![Image 11: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/IMG_1569_JPG_40b7e9f0c1.jpeg)](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-expands-saudi-arabia-portfolio-with-new-jeddah-development-valued-at-sar-1-billion "Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion") Oct 26, 2026 ### [Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-capital-partners-targets-high-value-real-estate-opportunities-dubai "Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate") Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai. [![Image 12: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/f3e36f564f5f_469af29be0.webp)](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-capital-partners-targets-high-value-real-estate-opportunities-dubai "Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate") Oct 07, 2026 ### [Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-opens-sales-trump-villas-simaisma-qatar-unprecedented-interest "Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest") Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, has officially opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, witnessing unprecedented demand and strong investor interest since sales launched on 1 October. [![Image 13: Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/image00001_9baaae9214.webp)](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-opens-sales-trump-villas-simaisma-qatar-unprecedented-interest "Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest") Sep 30, 2026 ### [Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-delivers-66-percent-revenue-growth-hy-2026-portfolio-gdv-reaches-23-billion "Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln") Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). [![Image 14: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/Gold_course_b02356099a.jpeg)](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-delivers-66-percent-revenue-growth-hy-2026-portfolio-gdv-reaches-23-billion "Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln") Aug 06, 2026 ### [Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-appoints-gulf-asia-contracting-for-trump-international-hotel-tower-dubai "Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai") Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the construction contract to Gulf Asia Contracting for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Following the successful completion of all enabling works, due in September 2026, this appointment marks the project's transition into the next stage of construction and another significant milestone in the delivery of one of Dubai's most anticipated luxury developments. [![Image 15: Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/TTD_exterior_12_1_67e563181c.webp)](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-appoints-gulf-asia-contracting-for-trump-international-hotel-tower-dubai "Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai") Jun 29, 2026 ### [Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/darglobal-fendi-casa-announce-azure-oceanfront-villas-oman "Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman") Dar Global and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally. [![Image 16: Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/azureoceanfrontvillas2_jpg_822d7f4e89.webp)](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/darglobal-fendi-casa-announce-azure-oceanfront-villas-oman "Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman") Jun 18, 2026 ### [DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Master Community Infrastructure Contract To Compass And Bin Omairah In Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-awards-sar-338-million-rayana-master-community-infrastructure-contract-compass-bin-omairah-wadi-safar-diriyah-riyadh "DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Master Community Infrastructure Contract To Compass And Bin Omairah In Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh") DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded a SAR 338 million infrastructure contract for its ultra-exclusive Rayana community in Wadi Safar, Riyadh, to Compass and Bin Omairah Company for Contracting LLC [![Image 17: DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Master Community Infrastructure Contract To Compass And Bin Omairah In Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh](https://cdn.darglobal.co.uk/IMG_9532_JPG_48dda586d7.jpeg)](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/dar-global-awards-sar-338-million-rayana-master-community-infrastructure-contract-compass-bin-omairah-wadi-safar-diriyah-riyadh "DarGlobal Awards SAR 338 Million Rayana Master Community Infrastructure Contract To Compass And Bin Omairah In Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh") Jun 16, 2026 ### [DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future](https://darglobal.co.uk/press/darglobal-five-years-global-expansion-23bn-development-portfolio-future-vision "DarGlobal marks five years of global expansion with $23bln development portfolio and a bold vision for the future") London-listed luxury real estate developer DarGlobal celebrates its fifth anniversary, reaching a $23 billion development portfolio across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Spain, Greece and the UK, serving investors from over 125 nationalities. Darglobal plc secured this USD 250 million financing as part of its continued growth and expansion across key global markets. title: Wasalt Privacy Policy
content: Last Updated: 07/01/2025. This Privacy Policy applies to Wasalt App and Web, which offer real estate listing services, and Wasalt Business App, which offers real estate property management services. Wasalt describes collection of personal information, business information, device information, activity data, location data, and third-party data. Data is collected directly from users and automatically through cookies, tracking technologies, and analytics. Uses include service delivery, platform improvement, communication, market research, compliance, and legal obligations. Information may be shared with brokers, agents, developers, business partners, suppliers, subcontractors, cloud hosting, analytics and marketing providers, and legally authorized authorities. Wasalt states it does not sell personal data. Users may request access, correction, or deletion by contacting support@wasalt.com. The policy also describes user controls, consent, assignment in corporate transactions, security measures, and policy updates.
